company.description: Core provides team collaboration software that combines chats, channels, calendars, voice calls, video conferences, screen sharing, and shared documentation. The platform is designed for cross-functional teams that need communication and workflow tools in one workspace. Core supports desktop use on macOS and Windows and includes a modular structure for different team functions.
